shared_elements: predatory animal head with bared teeth/fangs
frontal anthropomorphic head with prominent eyes
arms/hands rendered schematically against the body
hierarchical vertical ordering of beast above human-like figure
horizontal band separating upper zone from lower figures (B) / horizontal division between stacked heads (A)
justification: Both depict a totemic vertical stack in which a fanged predatory beast is set above a frontal, wide-eyed anthropomorphic figure whose schematic arms and hands are shown clasped over the body below, a fairly specific superimposed-being scheme rather than a generic animal frieze. The biggest differences in content are B's additional repertoire — a row of animals in an upper register, a zigzag band, and two long-necked birds in profile — and its relief presentation of paired large-and-small figures, none of which appear in A's simpler two-headed column.
